verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. No declaration writes the two difference derivatives in this displayed form; the content is stated in the integrated form and recovered by one differentiation. The recovery: `controlled_sub` gives controlled T κ F - F = -weightedPrimitive T κ (radialPartial F), and `weightedPrimitive_hasDerivAt` differentiates the right side to -activation T κ y · radialPartial F (y,η) = -e_a ∂_y F. Taking F = L (the log angular field, so log φ - log φ_r = controlled T κ L - L) and substituting radialPartial L = -referenceP1/2 = -p_{1,r}/2 gives ∂_y(log φ - log φ_r) = e_a p_{1,r}/2. Taking F = U and substituting radialPartial U = -(radius · referenceNs)/2 = -X n_{s,r}/2 gives ∂_y(U - U_r) = e_a X n_{s,r}/2. The same two identities also follow by subtracting `activation_angular_equation` / `activation_axial_equation` (damping = 1 - e_a) from the corresponding reference derivatives, which is literally the paper's 'subtracting its equations'. Signs, the factor 2 and the X in the second equation all match; no constant or exponent differs.
